title: Chinese Threat Actor Uses Leaked DarkSword Kit to Deploy GHOSTBLADE on iOS
summary: An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword exploit kit.
card_summary: An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword exploit kit.
email_summary:
An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword exploit kit. Attack surface management platform Censys said it identified the threat actor running more than 100 web properties, most of which are fake Amazon Web Services (AWS) sign-in pages on a domain that also hosts the exploit toolkit.

title: PNLD Breach Exposes U.K. Police and Government Contact Details on Dark Web
summary: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web.
card_summary: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web.

sections.context: This fits the broader data-exposure trend where follow-on abuse of leaked information is common.

email_summary: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web. The data included names, organisations and work email addresses belonging to police officers, police staff, criminal justice professionals, government partners and customers.
